Jobs unveils the iPhone at the Macworld conference.
The half-inch-thick, 1.5 pound, 9.7 inch iPad allows users to read books, play games or watch video.
Jobs receives a standing ovation when he takes the stage to unveil the iPad 2.
At the Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC) Jobs introduces iCloud the new online media storage system.
Other Apple officials demo the new operating systems OS-X Lion and iOS-5.
